# United Rubber Cork (URC)

> Engineered Cork Solutions for Industry. Direct manufacturer of precision rubberised cork sheets, transformer gaskets, agglomerated natural cork, and vibration isolation materials based in GIDC Vapi, Gujarat, India.

## About United Rubber Cork
- **Company Name**: United Rubber Cork (URC)
- **Manufacturing Plant**: No. 5, Balaji Complex, Opp. Hansa Engg. Compound, Near Mahakali Weight Bridge, 2nd Phase, GIDC, Vapi - 396195, Gujarat, India
- **Experience**: Over 13 years of specialized compounding and manufacturing expertise in the Indian cork industry.
- **Key Standards**: Conforms to IS: 4253 (Part I & II), ASTM F104, BS Specifications.
- **Official Website**: https://amcorkindia.com
- **Contact**: admin@amcorkindia.com | +91 9924304617

## Core Product Categories & Capabilities
- [Cork Products](https://amcorkindia.com/products/cork-products): High-density natural agglomerated cork sheets, continuous rolls, blocks, stoppers, and expansion joint boards.
- [Rubberised Cork](https://amcorkindia.com/products/rubberised-cork): Nitrile (NBR), Neoprene, and SBR-bonded composite sheets, transformer gasket frames, and CNC-cut hermetic sealing rings.
- [Decorative Cork](https://amcorkindia.com/products/decorative-cork): Acoustic wall panels, pinboards, and architectural tactile tiles.
- [Cork Gifts](https://amcorkindia.com/products/cork-gifts): Custom laser-engraved sustainable corporate desk stationery and lifestyle accessories.

## Technical Applications
- Electrical Power Transformers (Tank covers, radiator headers, bushing turrets, conservator seals resisting hot mineral oil).
- Automotive & Transmission (Crankcase, valve cover, timing belt, and fuel pump flange gaskets).
- Civil Infrastructure & Construction (Concrete pavement foundation expansion joints, structural bridge filler boards).
- Heavy Machinery Vibration Damping (Generator foundations, printing press shock isolation, railway track pads).
